name: the host accepts an attach before its Worker holds the life lock
the host does not watch its own Worker
replace:
/\ watch' = [watch EXCEPT ![d] = <<d, gen[d]>>]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<role, lease, gen, conn, view, deaths>>
/\ UNCHANGED <<role, lease, gen, conn, watch, view, deaths>>

name: a failed host keeps the lease
an attached document shows the failure
a host runs a Worker that holds no life lock
replace:
/\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![d] = "failed"]
  /\ lease' = "none"
  /\ worker' = [worker EXCEPT ![d] = "none"]
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![d] = "failed"]
  /\ deaths' = deaths + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, conn, watch>>

/\ worker' = [worker EXCEPT ![d] = "alive"]
  /\ deaths' = deaths + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<role, lease, gen, conn, watch, view>>
